Reference / compression/deflate

compression/deflate#

raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951) without a header or checksum, as inside ZIP entries (#183).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let packed = DeflateCompressed(data).bytes();
let data = DeflateDecompressed(origin: packed, limit: 10485760).bytes();

Description#

raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951) without a header or checksum, as inside ZIP entries (#183).

A stream goes through the Compressing and Decompressing roles, for example with compression/read:

let packed = CompressedReading(origin: input, compressor: DeflateCompressor());

Decompression is bounded: limit is the most bytes it may produce, past which it throws CompressionLimitExceeded; damaged data is InvalidCompressedData.
